description:
Manage buffer.md, the staging queue for captures. You add entries, then flush them into each thread's daily log.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date D] — append an UNKNOWN quick capture (blocks flush; avoid)
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date D] — append a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date D] — append a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] [--date D] — append an ACTION (same as `tasks add`)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup entries by thread and date, and validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, write each thread's logs/, clear the buffer, and ingest flushed ACTIONs into tasks

Args:
  THREAD       'Kind/Name', name or wikilink
  TEXT         for add-action: '(Assignee) description' or 'description'
  TARGET       Kind/Name, Kind/Name/hours, Kind/Name/payments, Kind/Name/logs/YYYY-MM-DD, a note stem, or people/<Name>
  SUMMARY      optional words shown after the link
  FILTER       case-insensitive text; only matching lines are shown
  LINE_NUMBER  integer from `buffer list`

Flags:
  global, before the subcommand:
    --quiet              suppress info output
  add, add-text, add-ref, add-action:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD    file under the day the thing happened, not today
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD, --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD, --priority H|M|L, --depends UUID8 (repeatable)
  list:
    --json

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/Northwind", "Agreed revised scope with Sam Rivera"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/Northwind", "people/Sam Rivera", "call follow-up"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/Northwind", "(Jordan Blake) Send revised scope", "--due", "2026-10-31"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never edit buffer.md directly.
  Do not use `add`. UNKNOWN entries fail tend and block flush until you remove them with `rm` and re-add them with the matching add-* subcommand.
  `flush` writes logs at threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md and ingests ACTIONs, so you do not need to run `tasks` afterwards. Its report lines:
    'already a task: <uuid> <path:line> <description>' — the ACTION matches an open task and is skipped
    'already buffered' — a repeat within the buffer
    'due updated: ... due:<old> -> <new>' — only the due date differed, so that task's due date was moved
    'ambiguous' — the ACTION matched several open tasks; nothing changed
  Run `list` again before each `rm` to get current line numbers.
  Exit 1 means a line number that is not an integer, is out of range or is empty, or another failure with its reason on stderr (for example, validation errors from tend or flush).
